results.description:
A billionaire bad boy brought to his knees by the one woman he shouldn't want.

Once, I had it all—wealth, power, women. But reckless choices cost me everything. Now I'm clawing my way back from rock bottom, determined to prove I'm more than the mistakes I've made.

Enter Carter Remington. Gorgeous. Fierce. Untouchable. She's not only my complete opposite—she's off-limits. My friend's cousin. My employee. The one woman I should resist.

But every moment with Carter is temptation. Every look, every touch threatens to undo me. If I cross the line, I could lose what little I've rebuilt. But if I walk away, I'll regret it forever.

He's So Bad is a steamy, emotional forbidden romance about second chances, redemption, and a love worth risking it all for. Book 6 in the Steamy Destinations Romance Series.

Perfect for readers who love bad boy redemption arcs, forbidden office romance, and billionaire heroes who fall hard.
